# TRANSCEND International

> > TRANSCEND International is a global peace research and education organization founded by Johan Galtung, offering peace studies, solutions-oriented journalism, and conflict transformation resources.

TRANSCEND International operates through multiple interconnected platforms including TRANSCEND Peace University for online education, TRANSCEND Media Service for peace journalism, TRANSCEND University Press for academic publishing, and TRANSCEND Research Institute for peace research. The organization is rooted in Johan Galtung's pioneering work on peace studies, nonviolence, and conflict resolution.

## Education & Research

- [TRANSCEND Peace University](https://www.transcend.org/tpu): Online university offering peace studies courses and certifications
- [TRANSCEND Research Institute](https://www.transcend.org/tri): Research institute for peace studies and conflict transformation
- [TRANSCEND University Press](https://www.transcend.org/tup): Academic publisher for peace research and TRANSCEND network

## Peace Journalism & Media

- [TRANSCEND MEDIA SERVICE](https://www.transcend.org/tms): Solutions-oriented peace journalism platform by TRANSCEND
- [A Note from the TMS Editor](https://www.transcend.org/tms/2026/03/a-note-from-the-tms-editor): Editor's note from Antonio C. S. Rosa on TMS operations
- [I Am Ashamed to Be an American](https://www.transcend.org/tms/2026/03/i-am-ashamed-to-be-an-american): Opinion piece on US foreign policy and Iran conflict
- [Remembering Civil Rights Icon Bernard Lafayette](https://www.transcend.org/tms/2026/03/remembering-civil-rights-icon-bernard-lafayette-29-jul-1940-5-mar-2026): Memorial tribute to civil rights activist Bernard Lafayette
- [We Have a Dream](https://www.transcend.org/tms/2026/03/we-have-a-dream): Editorial cartoon and commentary on war crimes and power
- [World's Road to Hell is Paved by Crusading US White Christians and Genocidal Messianic Israeli Jews](https://www.transcend.org/tms/2026/03/worlds-road-to-hell-is-paved-by-crusading-us-white-christians-and-genocidal-messianic-israeli-jews): Analysis of religious nationalism and geopolitical conflicts
- [UAE Billionaire to Trump: Who Authorized You to Turn Our Region Into a War Zone](https://www.transcend.org/tms/2026/03/uae-billionaire-to-trump-who-authorized-you-to-turn-our-region-into-a-war-zone): UAE perspective on Trump administration Middle East policy
